nodes.label: Unit 2 Algebraic Fractional Functions and the operations on them (Algebra)
Define set of zeroes
nodes.description: Evaluate a polynomial function at given values of x and state the set of zeroes Z(f) as the values of x for which f(x)=0.

nodes.label: Find set of zeroes
nodes.description: Find the set of zeroes Z(f) of a polynomial function by putting f(x) = 0 and solving the resulting equation for x, including cases with no zeroes.

nodes.label: Domain of algebraic fraction
nodes.description: Determine the domain of an algebraic fractional function as R minus the set of zeroes of the denominator, and evaluate the function at given values.

nodes.label: Common domain of fractions
nodes.description: Calculate the common domain of two or more algebraic fractions as R minus the union of the zeroes of their denominators.

nodes.label: Reducing algebraic fractions with domain
nodes.description: Reduce an algebraic fraction to its simplest form by factorizing numerator and denominator, and state its domain before cancelling common factors.

nodes.label: Equality of two algebraic fractions
nodes.description: Determine whether two algebraic fractions are equal by comparing their domains and their simplest forms, and find the common domain when they are not equal.

nodes.label: Add and subtract algebraic fractions
nodes.description: Add and subtract algebraic fractions with common or different denominators, factorising denominators, using the L.C.M., giving the result in simplest form with its domain.

nodes.label: Multiply and divide algebraic fractions
nodes.description: Multiply and divide algebraic fractions by factorising and cancelling, dividing by multiplying by the multiplicative inverse (reciprocal) of the second, giving the simplest form and the domain.

questions.stem: Complete the following: If $n_1(x)=\frac{-7}{x+2}$, $n_2(x)=\frac{x}{x-k}$ and the common domain of two function $n_1, n_2$ is $\mathbb{R}-\{-2, 7\}$ then $k=$ ............
